metadata.title: ProgramManagement
metadata.description: This Module makes it easier to Install/Uninstall programs on Windows, regardless of the method of installation (PSGet, Chocolatey CmdLine, .msi, etc). GitHub: https://github.com/pldmgg/ProgramManagement
